title: How cancer patients became lost in a Queensland hospital crisis
paragraphs: An investigation has exposed how Townsville Hospital and Health Service (THHS) failed to tell its patients they had aggressive cancers needing urgent treatment.
Doctors who have reviewed the more than 200-page report, released this week, say warning signs about poor hospital resourcing had been evident for years.
Queensland Health has accepted, in principle, 27 recommendations made by investigators.
